title: Methane Ice（可燃冰）
description: "The Methane Ice mod adds a new type of fuel to the game that has a higher combustion efficiency."
body:
Methane Ice Module adds a new type of fuel to the game with higher burning efficiency.

Methane Ice Crystal: A combustible substance made of natural gas (methane) and ice. Can smelt 512 items.

Methane Ice: An ice-like block that allows sliding like normal ice. A single piece has a fuel capacity of 4608 items.

Methane Ice Harvester: A work block used to harvest Methane Ice Crystals. After placing it on a block, right-click to check whether a Methane Ice Crystal vein exists in the current chunk. When activated by redstone, it mines the vein. The harvested crystals are automatically stored inside and can be automatically output to containers placed above, or extracted via pipes.

可燃冰模组给游戏中添加了一种燃烧效率更高效的燃料。

可燃冰晶：一种天然气（甲烷）和冰结合的可燃物。能够熔炼512个物品
。
可燃冰：一种冰状方块可以像普通冰一样滑行，一个就可以容量4608个物品。

可燃冰采集机：用于采集可燃冰晶的工作方块，放置在方块上后，右键可查看当前区块是否存在可燃冰晶矿脉。用红石激活就可以开采矿脉，开采出来的矿脉会自动存入内部，并且可以自动输出与上方的容器，也可以使用管道导出。
